GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiDrawing class.

GetDescription.description: Gets the description of the current drawing.

returns.description: The description of the current drawing, or null if not set.

GetFill.description: Gets the fill formatting properties from the current graphic object.

GetFlipH.description: Get horizontal flip of current drawing.

returns.description: Returns true if the figure is flipped horizontally, false if not, or null if the drawing properties are not available.

GetFlipV.description: Get vertical flip of current drawing.

returns.description: Returns true if the figure is flipped vertically, false if not, or null if the drawing properties are not available.

GetHeight.description: Returns the height of the current drawing.

GetLine.description: Gets the outline properties from the current graphic object.

GetLockAspect.description: Returns whether the aspect ratio of the drawing is locked.

GetLockValue.description: Returns the lock value for the specified lock type of the current drawing.

params.description: Lock type in the string format.
params.name: sType

GetName.description: Returns the name of the current drawing.

GetParentSheet.description: Returns the parent sheet of the current drawing.

GetRotation.description: Returns the rotation angle of the current drawing object.

GetShadow.description: Returns the shadow of the current graphic object.

GetTitle.description: Gets the title of the current drawing.

returns.description: The title of the current drawing, or null if not set.

GetWidth.description: Returns the width of the current drawing.

params.description: Specifies whether the selection should replace the current selection (true) or be added to it (false).
params.name: isReplace

SetDescription.description: Sets the description of the current drawing.

params.description: The description to set for the current drawing.
params.name: description

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful, false otherwise.

SetFill.description: Sets the fill formatting properties to the current graphic object.

params.description: The fill type used to fill the graphic object.
params.name: fill

returns.description: returns false if param is invalid or not supported for the current graphic object.

SetFlipH.description: Sets the horizontal flip of the current drawing.

params.description: Specifies if the figure will be flipped horizontally or not.
params.name: bFlip

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful, false otherwise.

SetFlipV.description: Sets the vertical flip of the current drawing.

params.description: Specifies if the figure will be flipped vertically or not.
params.name: bFlip

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful, false otherwise.

SetLockAspect.description: Sets whether the aspect ratio of the drawing is locked.

params.description: Specifies whether the aspect ratio of this drawing is locked.
params.name: bAspect

returns.description: Returns `true` if the lock aspect was successfully set, otherwise returns `false`.

SetLockValue.description: Sets the lock value to the specified lock type of the current drawing.

params.description: Lock type in the string format.
params.name: sType

params.description: Specifies if the specified lock is applied to the current drawing.
params.name: bValue

SetName.description:
Sets the name of the current drawing.
If another drawing with the same name already exists, that drawing's name will be reset to a default auto-generated name.
OLE objects do not support a custom name, so for them this method always returns false.

params.description: The name which will be set to the current drawing.
params.name: name

returns.description: Returns true if the name was successfully set, otherwise returns false.

SetOutLine.description: Sets the outline properties to the specified graphic object.

params.description: The stroke used to create the graphic object outline.
params.name: stroke

returns.description: returns false if param is invalid.

SetPosition.description:
Changes the position for the drawing object.
<note>Please note that the horizontal and vertical offsets are calculated within the limits of
the specified column and row cells only. If this value exceeds the cell width or height, another vertical/horizontal position will be set.</note>

params.description: The number of the column where the beginning of the drawing object will be placed.
params.name: nFromCol

params.description: The offset from the nFromCol column to the left part of the drawing object measured in English measure units.
params.name: nColOffset

params.description: The number of the row where the beginning of the drawing object will be placed.
params.name: nFromRow

params.description: The offset from the nFromRow row to the upper part of the drawing object measured in English measure units.
params.name: nRowOffset

SetPosition.signature: SetPosition(nFromCol: number, nColOffset: EMU, nFromRow: number, nRowOffset: EMU): void

SetRotation.description: Sets the rotation angle to the current drawing object.

params.description: New drawing rotation angle.
params.name: nRotAngle

SetShadow.description: Sets the shadow to the current graphic object.

params.description: The shadow to apply, or null to remove the current shadow.
params.name: shadow

returns.description: returns false if the graphic object does not support shadow.

SetSize.description: Sets a size of the object (image, shape, chart) bounding box.

params.description: The object width measured in English measure units.
params.name: nWidth

params.description: The object height measured in English measure units.
params.name: nHeight

SetTitle.description: Sets the title of the current drawing.

params.description: The title to set for the current drawing.
params.name: title

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful, false otherwise.

Unselect.description: Removes the current drawing from the selection.

returns.description: Returns false if the drawing or controller is not available, otherwise returns true.
